goal: Navigate to https://etenders.hry.nic.in/nicgep/app to complete the goal: On the Haryana e-procurement home page, open the 'Latest Tenders' list (use 'more' if shown) and find tenders related to 'storage rack' (match on title). For each matching row read: bid_no (tender reference number or tender ID), title, buyer (department), end_date (closing date), doc_url (absolute link of the tender title). If the only way to search is a form with a captcha, return what is visible in the latest list instead. Today is 25 Oct 2026. Only keep bids closing on or after 27 Oct 2026 (skip anything closing sooner). Relevance: keep a bid only if its items/title describe 'storage rack' itself or a close variant; never keep a bid just because the ministry, department or organisation name contains a search word. Return at most 10 bids. If a captcha, OTP or login wall appears, do NOT try to solve it: stop immediately and return blocked=true with blocked_reason and an empty bids list. blocked is ONLY for captcha/login/site errors: if the site works but nothing relevant is found, return blocked=false and an empty bids list. This is read-only: never click submit, participate, or bid buttons. Copy values exactly as shown (end_date with its time, est_value in INR as shown); use absolute URLs for doc_url; use an empty string for anything not shown.
